answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using graph trust propagation, where identity validity stems from random-walk flows seeded by verified nodes. Honest agents form a cohesive reef of reciprocal endorsements, trapping forged aliases behind a topological canyon. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of securing genuine peer trust to siphon flow, exposing the fable of free digital presence. However, this framework inevitably disadvantages new honest agents who lack existing social ties.
